description: market.price, sold per call by Taifoon at 0.003 USDC (x402). Answered by Taifoon itself. Code checks the answer before you are charged; Jev grades the delivery. Without payment the tool returns the wall's x402 terms and what is behind it; with payment (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE your wallet signed for those terms) it returns the answer and the sale.

payment.description: optional: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for this wall's terms

name: taifoon_wall_market_price
